name: KLX land-price bands
modelStatus: District-scale listing/media bands, not NAPIC parcels or Treasury appraisal.

properties.name: KLCC
properties.unit: RM per sq ft (listing/media) and converted RM per m²
properties.caveat: Luxury condo listing range, media 2026 summaries. Not NAPIC appraisal. Appraised ≠ market. These polygons are district-scale boxes, not cadastral parcels.
properties.source: Media/listing summaries 2026 (trxklccproperty and similar). Official NAPIC Laporan Pasaran Harta 2025 exists as PDF and is not ingested.
